instructions.step1: Log in to your Icedrive account at https://icedrive.net/login.
instructions.step2: Navigate to Settings › Access › WebDAV to enable access and view your WebDAV password.
instructions.step3: Enter your Icedrive account email and password to mount ~/Icedrive.
